recognize_zh: 上方淋巴細胞核略有凹陷、胞質量比典型 CLL 細胞多且淡藍；下方細胞核圓、染色質塊狀、胞質稀少，較接近典型 CLL 細胞。同一抹片中混有核形不規則與胞質較多的細胞，是 12 號染色體三體 CLL 非典型型態的線索。
features: Upper cell: slightly indented nucleus with moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Lower cell: round nucleus with clumped (soccer-ball-like) chromatin and scant cytoplasm
No visible nucleoli in either cell
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small lymphocytes. One has a round nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, typical of CLL cells, whereas the other shows a slightly indented nuclear contour with a more generous rim of pale blue cytoplasm. Nucleoli are not evident. In the context of a CLL immunophenotype, this admixture of typical and cleaved, more cytoplasmic cells is compatible with CLL with atypical morphology, as seen with trisomy 12.

ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap, but cells are CD23-negative/dim with cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity and t(11;14).
Morphologically identical to CLL cells; separated only by a clonal B-cell count below 5 x 10^9/L without tissue involvement.
Look the same individually; a clonal CD5+/CD23+ population with light-chain restriction on flow cytometry is required.
